prompt:
PLAN 01 — ALTERNATE COVERAGE | THE HOUSE BEFORE THE INTRUSION

Create a 15-second cinematic sequence for Seedance 2.5.
Horizontal 16:9.
Exactly three shots lasting six, five and four seconds.

CHARACTER REFERENCES:
Shahrnaz = {{CHAR_SHAHRNAZ}}
Arnavaz = {{CHAR_ARNAVAZ}}
Musician = {{CHAR_MUSICIAN}}

ANIMAL REFERENCE:
Cat = {{ANIMAL_CAT}}

LOCATION REFERENCE:
The sisters’ furnished home interior = {{LOC_PRIVATE_ROOM}}

PROP REFERENCE:
Intact instrument = {{PROP_INSTRUMENT}}

Preserve the referenced architecture, furnishings, plants, masks, costumes, hairstyles and instrument design.

START STATE AND BLOCKING:

A quiet domestic moment inside the sisters’ home.

Shahrnaz and Arnavaz sit beside each other on the existing referenced seating, their bodies angled slightly toward one another.

Viewed from the front:
Shahrnaz occupies SCREEN-LEFT.
Arnavaz occupies SCREEN-RIGHT.

The cat rests beside Shahrnaz on the outer, screen-left end of the seat.

The musician sits several meters behind them, deeper SCREEN-RIGHT, holding the intact instrument.

The camera remains on the same front side of the sisters throughout all three shots.

SHOT 01A | 00:00–00:06 | THE HOME HOLDS THEM

18mm extreme-wide interior long shot from the far side of the room, at standing eye level, framed through an existing doorway.

Reveal the full breadth of the referenced home: its ceiling height, floor, furnishings and established plants.

The doorway edges create a dark foreground frame. The sisters appear small together in the middle distance, slightly left of center. The musician occupies a separate deeper layer on the right.

Use a slow handheld advance of half a meter through the doorway. The movement gradually opens the view of the room while retaining its generous scale.

Shahrnaz turns her masked head slightly toward Arnavaz. Arnavaz shifts her weight closer to her sister.

The cat remains settled beside Shahrnaz. The musician makes small playing movements with the instrument.

SHOT 01B | 00:06–00:11 | AN ORDINARY INTIMACY

Cut to a 40mm medium two-shot from the same front side, at the sisters’ seated eye level.

Shahrnaz remains SCREEN-LEFT, facing slightly right.
Arnavaz remains SCREEN-RIGHT, facing slightly left.

Include both masks, shoulders and hands. The cat is visible beside Shahrnaz at the left edge. The musician remains softly present in the right background.

Arnavaz notices a loose strand of Shahrnaz’s hair resting against the edge of her mask.

She raises her right hand and gently moves the strand back into its existing arrangement.

Shahrnaz inclines her head toward her sister to make the small adjustment easier.

The camera drifts slightly closer with quiet handheld breathing.

SHOT 01C | 00:11–00:15 | THE MOMENT AFTER

Cut to a 65mm intimate two-shot from the same side of their shared axis, slightly closer to Shahrnaz while retaining both women.

Shahrnaz’s mask occupies the left third in three-quarter view, turned toward Arnavaz.
Arnavaz’s opposing three-quarter profile occupies the right third, turned toward Shahrnaz.

Continue Arnavaz’s hand withdrawing from the completed hair adjustment. Her hand settles into her own lap.

Shahrnaz keeps her head inclined toward her for a brief beat, then both women turn their attention slightly toward the musician off-screen right.

Hold their relaxed shoulders and unhurried breathing.

End within the quiet moment, with the cat still resting beside Shahrnaz.

LIGHT AND IMAGE:

Warm available daylight enters through the referenced window opening. Soft reflected light reveals fabric, hair, mask texture and the cat’s fur.

Keep the home warm and inhabited. Preserve the established furnishings and plants in their original positions.

Natural exposure, tactile materials, restrained analog texture and gentle organic camera movement.

SOUND:

Quiet interior air, soft clothing movement, fingertips brushing hair, the cat’s breathing and unpitched finger contact against the instrument.

NO MUSIC, NO DIALOGUE.

Established requirements for this subject:
- No human appears without a mask. Every person on screen, including nobles, gift-bearers, servants and background figures, wears a mask. A figure who is not a named character takes one of the masked caste looks in REF-001, Civilization Caste Board. Never show a bare human face.

<<<image_3>>> is Musician (CHR-006 V02); match it wherever Musician appears.
<<<image_4>>> is Cat Persian Longhair (CRT-004 V01); match it wherever Cat Persian Longhair appears.
